articles.title: Nvidia forms 37-member AI security alliance without OpenAI, Anthropic or Google
articles.snippet: The chipmaker and 36 other companies say defenders need AI they can run themselves. Major AI players OpenAI, Anthropic and Google are not among them.

articles.title: Bitcoin options traders are dropping their hedges going into the Fed meeting
articles.snippet: The put/call ratio has fallen to about 0.52 from 0.76 in late June, and one-week downside protection has collapsed in price. The options market is positioned for a quiet week that contains an FOMC decision.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs post third straight weekly inflows despite $465 million in late-week losses
articles.snippet: The vast majority of the activity was concentrated in BlackRock’s IBIT product accounting for nearly $415 million of the outflows.

articles.title: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong criticizes crypto startups that rebrand to AI
articles.snippet: Armstrong said blockchain technology acts as a general-purpose infrastructure that will underpin future automation rather than competing with it.

articles.title: Crypto steadies as Iran-U.S. pause sends oil tumbling, lifts risk assets
articles.snippet: Brent crude plunged 7% after the U.S. and Iran paused Strait of Hormuz strikes, lifting equities and DeFi tokens while bitcoin held near $65,000 ahead of a pivotal Fed decision Wednesday.
